precision_scope: Existing adapted F16 native contract; not original Diffbot full-runtime equivalence.
question: Does skipping only the RAM-cache MADV_HUGEPAGE hint remove first-touch stalls without regressing the declared first-visit/revisit and token-latency workload?

control.base_definition: Skip this one advice call. With the fixed system THP=madvise policy this leaves the cache on the system page policy; it is not a promise of4KiB pages under arbitrary global settings.
control.hint_definition: Call the unchanged platform helper on the same allocation before first use.
control.unchanged: Model/quant arithmetic, router, cache/staging/activation quotas, admission, CPU affinity and compiled compute bodies.

plan.previous_goal_turn: progress: sealed four independent domain references,360exact product comparisons and byte/cache evidence that exposed cold-loading delay.
plan.scope: Per-allocation huge-page advice control, current frozen shared-fused/lookahead native product, four fixed1026-token domains repeated,8requests,2live,5outputs. The same diagnostic wrapper binary executes both normal hint and base modes; no production code, model math, routing, cache quota, staging, thread or global kernel setting change.
plan.metrics: Untraced client receipt first admission to last completion, first-visit cohorts0/1 versus revisit cohorts2/3; wait4 target maxRSS,faults,user/system CPU and filesystem input. Per-request inter-token intervals include prefill interference. Read global VM/buddy/THP metadata only before/after target, not as process-attributed counters.
acceptance: All immutable independent full-head controls pass:40heads per correctness run,160total. Timings check every emitted token/text/position prefix.
One page-advice call with identical allocation size204527370240 bytes per process; only advice execution differs.
Identical source/upload bytes, compute counts, pool reuse geometry and managed caps across modes.
For an OS-warm speed claim, all six timed target filesystem-input block counts must be zero. If not, retain the incomplete comparison and repeat the same declared protocol, rather than retuning it.

At least20% paired geometric mean first-visit throughput improvement for base versus hint, with revisit latency and mixed mean/p95 inter-token latency ratios no worse than1.05. This is a decision gate for a page-policy candidate, not release readiness.

Preserve all runs and negative outcomes. Do not infer exact physical-device peaks or controlled global memory fragmentation; natural memory conditions and unlocked CPU affinity remain recorded limitations.

assessment.throughput_scope: Fixed four-domain first-visit/revisit request bursts with five outputs, not pure prefill or sustained-serving qualification.

correctness.criteria: Full F32 vocabulary bytes, recorded input IDs, generated IDs, concatenated streaming UTF8 and positions against immutable independent four-domain references; normal and ASAN/UBSAN modes.
correctness.timing_validation: Every token/text/position prefix checked separately in each untraced timed/warmup process.

interpretation.scope: Only the fixed OS-source-warm comparison if the zero-filesystem-input gate passes. First-visit bursts contain four1026-token prompts and five outputs per request; they are not pure prefill timing.
interpretation.decision: No production default change was made. Do not generalize a cold-memory observation into a universal no-hint improvement.
interpretation.conditional_default_guidance: Use the measured individual pairs and operating conditions. A failed candidate gate is preserved as a negative result, not relaxed after measurement.

cold_observations.interpretation: Correctness controls show large differences in source-path and system CPU time, but also in physical filesystem input. Their elapsed times do not isolate advice cost under matched storage/page conditions. Keep them distinct from the prospectively gated timed series.

kernel_context.summary: Kernel documentation states that the madvise THP defrag mode permits direct reclaim for MADV_HUGEPAGE regions. Huge-page advice therefore does not promise nonblocking first-touch allocation. Background promotion and global defrag controls are separate mechanisms.
kernel_context.inference: High system CPU and faults during the two observed cold RAM fills are consistent with memory-management stalls. These observations do not isolate THP compaction from all other costs; a matched per-process hint/no-hint control is required before changing production policy.

cold_observations.unresolved: Why advice experiences large cold-load stalls under some filesystem/memory conditions; warm-source results do not establish filesystem-cold or fragmented-memory tail behavior.

reproduction.raw_evidence: Exact argv, binary hashes, environment, client receipt timestamps, wait4 target resources and before/after VM/buddy/THP metadata retained. Global VM counters are context, not process attribution.
reproduction.native_environment: CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID,BN_CUDA_DEVICE=0;LD_PRELOAD/LD_LIBRARY_PATH unset. Only BN_PAGE_CONTROL differs between modes.
reproduction.snapshot_note: The archive stores the933 source/config/doc files frozen during the experiment, before this publication. Runtime control binaries and pinned shared-library references are retained separately.

limitations: One checkpoint/profile/GPU and three fixed timed pairs; no universal memory-page recommendation or vLLM-relative speed claim.
Natural memory allocation/fragmentation and unlocked CPU frequency/affinity are not controlled; before/after VM metadata is not a kernel-stack causal profile.
Mixed token intervals in this static request burst do not qualify sustained offered-load SLOs or all decode-only cases.
wait4 RSS is OS-reported and excludes OS file cache; exact physical device/setup peaks are not measured by this uninstrumented comparison.

Filesystem-cold page-policy behavior, explicit integrated allocation controls, varied-workload exposed transfers, native folded/decode sharing and broader CPU/Metal/performance qualification remain open.
next_action: Add explicit per-allocation RAM page advice to the cache/placement policy and product interfaces while retaining the measured existing default; qualify both modes, then isolate filesystem-cold setup costs and sustained offload SLOs.
